status: provisional, uncalibrated; frozen before empirical execution
calibration: No real-paper calibration available. Constants chosen from sampling-theory reasoning stated below; synthetic rule tests in checks/scoring_tests are the only calibration performed. Not validated error rates.
scorer: code: checks/scripts/score.py (written before outputs are read)

implementation_agreement.compare_first: implementations are compared with each other before any comparison with targets
implementation_agreement.rule: A quantity is implementation-agreed if at least two of three implementations agree within tolerance; scoring uses the mean of the agreeing pair (they agree within tolerance, so this is not averaging contradictory results); the third goes to code audit. No agreeing pair: indeterminate, sub-code implementation_disagreement.

rounding: Each published value v printed with k decimals is the interval [v - 0.5*10^-k, v + 0.5*10^-k]. Distances are measured from the reconstructed value to the nearest point of this interval (0 if inside). Differences of published values use interval arithmetic (endpoints combined).

focal_latent_contrasts.estimand: d_eq = (latent mean later - latent mean earlier) / sqrt((psi_earlier + psi_later)/2) from model M4, specification S00; scale: standardized mean difference; null value 0; sign: later minus earlier
focal_latent_contrasts.sign_criterion: Assessable if the published rounding interval excludes 0. Mismatch if the reconstructed d_eq has the opposite sign and its distance to the interval exceeds the magnitude grey bound; otherwise agree. Not assessable if the interval contains 0.

magnitude_criterion.unit: derived SE of d (adaptation; the article prints no SE for d): se_d = sqrt((n1+n2)/(n1*n2) + d_pub^2/(2*(n1+n2))) with n1, n2 the published Form 4 Ns of the two years from the sealed N branch and d_pub the printed value. This is a derived-SE check, not a published-SE check.
magnitude_criterion.regime: different_vintage_public_reconstruction (public confidentiality-modified weights, release vintages that may differ from the authors', undocumented missing-data handling)
magnitude_criterion.justification: Two SE corresponds to ordinary sampling-level disagreement between nearly identical samples; the extra width up to 4 SE reflects documented vintage and weighting differences of public reconstructions. Same-data bands would be 1/2/3 SE; not applicable here.

focal_latent_contrasts.inference_criterion: not audited: SEM benchmark retains native inference (scoring.md). Native two-sided Wald z of the latent contrast is reported descriptively against the article's significance wording.

item_level_claims.estimand: mean difference later - earlier on native item coding
item_level_claims.sign_criterion: as for focal contrasts, using the interval of (mean_later - mean_earlier) from printed means

magnitude_criterion.unit: derived SE from printed SDs and published form Ns: se = sqrt(sd_a^2/n_a + sd_b^2/n_b) (adaptation; no published SE)

inference_criterion.benchmark: native independent-samples Student t (no assignment-level clusters exist in the public files; none invented)
inference_criterion.published_mapping: *** or ** -> band 1 (p < .01; *** retained as a separate inequality check p < .001); * -> band 2; no star -> set {band 3, band 4}
inference_criterion.rule: band distance = minimum distance between reconstructed band and published band set. Distance >= 2 is an inference mismatch; distance 1 is never sufficient. For a published significance claim, a stronger reconstructed band is not a failure. Exact printed inequalities (p < .001) are recorded as separate checks.

diagnostic_claims.rule: Each diagnostic claim is scored on its stated decision (e.g. delta CFI below or above .002; chi-square difference significant at .05; RMSEA/CFI adequacy as the article states its cutoffs). Consistent if the reconstructed decision matches; discrepant_provisional if opposite with the reconstructed statistic outside the rounding interval of the decision threshold; indeterminate if the article's decision rule is not stated or the statistic lies within rounding of the threshold. Fit-index magnitudes are reported descriptively (no SE).

claim_outcome_precedence: not_attemptable: core input absent or all implementations fail at the origin
indeterminate/implementation_disagreement: no agreeing pair at the origin

discrepant_provisional: agreeing implementations mismatch on sign, two-or-more inference bands (item claims), or magnitude band 'mismatch'; requires adversarial review and human confirmation before any unqualified discrepant claim
indeterminate/grey_zone: any criterion in the grey band and none mismatched
indeterminate/inconsistent_targets: published record internally inconsistent for this cell (e.g. text vs table sign) and the outcome depends on which value is used
fragility: Equivalent set after reconciliation is empty: fragile and fragile-inference outcomes are not assessable; specification fragility not assessed. Uncertain branches are reported separately and never change the primary outcome.
label_sensitivity: Each claim is also scored under co-origin S01 (weighted). If the outcome differs from S00, the claim is flagged label_sensitive and both outcomes are preserved for a human-sourced decision.
missingness_failure_policy: Failed or unavailable specifications are retained with reasons and never count as agreement. Missing targets leave a criterion unassessed.

paper_aggregation.focal_structure: Five research-question claims RQ1-RQ5 (leisure K1, extrinsic K5, intrinsic K2, altruistic K3, social K4), each defined by its three contrasts P1-P3.
paper_aggregation.rq_rule: RQ consistent if all three contrasts consistent; RQ discrepant_provisional if any contrast has a sign mismatch or at least two contrasts are discrepant_provisional; otherwise, if any contrast is indeterminate or discrepant_provisional, RQ indeterminate (sub-code mixed or the contrast sub-code).
paper_aggregation.paper_rule: Any indeterminate RQ makes the paper indeterminate (scoring.md). Otherwise: fully reproduced if all five RQs consistent and no lower-tier claim is discrepant_provisional; partially reproduced if all RQs consistent and some lower-tier claim is discrepant_provisional; not reproduced if at least three RQs are discrepant_provisional; mixed_focal (reported separately, not forced into a category) if one or two RQs are discrepant_provisional and the rest consistent.
paper_aggregation.sensitivity: Report whether adding the work-centrality item set (tier uncertain) as a focal claim would change the paper outcome.

benchmark_inference_policy: Linear item comparisons: native independent-sample inference (no clusters available, few-cluster bootstrap not applicable). SEM latent contrasts: native, not audited.
n_branch: Sealed published Ns are compared by code with rows read per file (form N). Exact match required for 'match'; differences are reported, not tuned. Model and item Ns are not published.
compute_budget: Three implementations (one repair round each after checker review; further runtime repairs rechecked); grid S00-S08, CHK1-CHK2 per implementation; full influence run with implementation A (fallback order A, B, C only if A cannot run the mode); first 200 deletions cross-checked with implementation C.
